rules.noComments: NEVER write code comments (no //, no /* */, no JSDoc) in new or edited code. Leave existing comments untouched. Use descriptive names, named constants and small named helpers instead.
rules.style: Next 14 app router, TS strict, Tailwind with dark: variants, React Query v5, lucide-react icons. Match surrounding file conventions. Prefer pure functions in src/lib/domain/* with vitest tests next to them (*.test.ts). Small focused components; reuse Avatar, PlayerNameLink, POSITION_CLASSES, getPositionColor.
rules.ownership: Only edit files listed under your agent key in 'owners'. Need a change elsewhere? Do not make it; list it in your final report under 'requests'.
rules.verify: Typecheck with: npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | grep -E '<your paths>' (other agents work in parallel, ignore their errors). Run your tests with: npx vitest run <path>. Do NOT run next build or next dev.
rules.db: Run scripts against the real DB with: npm run db:script -- scripts/<file>.ts (handles corp CA + DNS). The user allows reading and adding fields/collections. Never delete user data.
rules.report: Final message: <=15 lines. Files touched, what is done, any 'requests' for other owners, anything not done.

stack.dirs: src/app (pages + api routes), src/components/<area>, src/lib/{domain,db,queries,api,notifications,hooks,store}, src/types/index.ts (client types), src/lib/db/collections.ts (DB types + collection getters)
stack.apiPattern: See src/app/api/users/[username]/stats/route.ts: requireAuth -> logApiRequest -> db -> success()/error() from lib/api/respond. export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'.
stack.clientFetch: apiFetch<T>(url) from src/lib/api/fetcher.ts; query keys in src/lib/queries/keys.ts
stack.installedPkgs: framer-motion@11, canvas-confetti (+types), web-push (+types), tsx (dev). Already installed; do not npm install anything else without listing it in requests.
stack.terminology: A 'match' is a whole session; a 'game' is one round inside it. 'Match win' = finished 1st in an ended match. 'Game win' = best score in a single round (entry.gamesWon). gamesPlayed = rounds played.

data.Match.standings: Optional MatchStanding[] cached on the match doc (collections.ts). Same order as computeMatchLeaderboard output. Recomputed by onRoundsChanged/onMatchEnded. Lets lists show leader/winner without loading scores.
data.playerStats: Collection 'playerStats', one doc per user (PlayerStats in collections.ts): rating, peakRating, ratedMatches, matchesPlayed, matchWins, podiums{first,second,third}, gamesWon, gamesPlayed, winPct (0..1 = gamesWon/gamesPlayed), averageRank. Rebuilt on match end. Only ended matches count toward rating/podiums; matchesPlayed/gamesWon/gamesPlayed count every match with >=1 round where player is not DNF.
data.pushSubscriptions: Collection 'pushSubscriptions' (PushSubscriptionDoc in collections.ts), unique by endpoint.
data.indexes: src/lib/db/indexes.ts already lists indexes for the new collections; ensureIndexes() is called by scripts/backfill-stats.ts.

contracts.events: src/lib/events/matchEvents.ts exports onRoundsChanged(matchId), onMatchEnded(matchId) and onMatchResumed(). onRoundsChanged: recomputeMatchStandings then rebuildAllPlayerStats + milestone notifications. onMatchEnded: same, then match-won notifications. onMatchResumed: rebuild stats + milestones. Wired into round submit/edit routes, the end-match PATCH and POST /api/matches/[id]/resume.
contracts.rating: Multi-player Elo. Start 1200. For each ended match in endedAt order, compare every pair of non-DNF players by final position (win 1 / tie 0.5 / loss 0). K = BASE_K * roundsWeight(roundsPlayed) / (n-1). roundsWeight grows with rounds (e.g. 3 rounds ~0.6, 10 rounds ~1.3, capped ~2) so a win in a long match earns more. DNF players count as last place. Ratings are per game: each game key (catalog type, or a slug of the free-text name for gameType other, e.g. exploding-kittens) is replayed on its own ladder. playerStats.rating/peakRating/ratedMatches stay the Least Count ladder; every game a player has rated matches in lives in playerStats.ratingsByGame[key] = { name, rating, peakRating, ratedMatches }.
contracts.statsApi: GET /api/users/[username]/stats -> { stats: PlayerStatsSummary & { wins, totalMatches, totalRounds }, profilePicUrl }. Legacy aliases: wins=matchWins, totalMatches=matchesPlayed, totalRounds=gamesPlayed. timesLeading is REMOVED. Reads one playerStats doc (+ a countDocuments for globalRank). Missing doc -> zeros with rating 1200. stats.ratingsByGame = [{ key, name, rating, peakRating, ratedMatches, globalRank }], least-count first; rating-history takes ?game=<key>.
contracts.leaderboardApi: GET /api/leaderboard?scope=friends|global&metric=rating|winPct|matchWins|gamesWon&game=<key>|_all&limit=50 -> { rows: LeaderboardRow[], self: LeaderboardRow | null, games: { key, name }[] }. game applies to every metric and defaults to least-count. game=_all (ALL_GAMES_KEY in lib/games/catalog.ts) ranks overall totals; rating is not offered for _all (server falls back to least-count). A specific game ranks ratingsByGame[game].record totals and that game rating, and only includes players with ratingsByGame[game].ratedMatches>0. Ranking happens in memory (lib/stats/leaderboard.ts rankableStatsFor + buildLeaderboard). winPct metric = match win rate (matchWins/matchesPlayed, row.matchWinRate); the stored PlayerStats.winPct field is gamesWon/gamesPlayed (strike rate) and is NOT used for the leaderboard. friends = viewer + friends (zero rows for friends with no stats under _all). global = users with gamesPlayed>0; rows = top N, self = viewer row with true rank. Sorts: rating desc then matchWins; winPct: matchWinRate desc then matchesPlayed; matchWins desc then rating; gamesWon desc then matchWins; then name.
contracts.matchesApi: GET /api/matches?from=ISO&to=ISO (both optional; filter createdAt in [from,to)) returns MatchSummary[] (src/types/index.ts) incl. createdAt, endedAt, gameType, gameLabel, leader (from standings[0] of non-DNF; isTied when standings[0].isSharedPosition; null when no rounds). Sorted createdAt desc. Without from/to keeps current behaviour.
contracts.matchWonNotification: type 'match-won', sent by onMatchEnded to every player with position 1 (ties included). payload: { matchId, matchName, roundsPlayed, ratingDelta: number|null, newRating: number|null }. Click target: /matches/{matchId}?celebrate=1
contracts.celebrateParam: Match page shows confetti burst when ?celebrate=1, and also once per browser per match (localStorage key 'celebrated:<matchId>') when the match is ended and the viewer finished 1st.
contracts.notificationTtl: Every notification gets expiresAt <= 2 days after createdAt (round-scored keeps 1 day). Existing rows with expiresAt null get createdAt+2d via a migration script.
contracts.push: notifyMany() in src/lib/notifications/create.ts fans out web-push to the recipients' pushSubscriptions after inserting, fire-and-forget, deleting subscriptions that return 404/410. Message text comes from a shared pure formatter so the in-app list and the push body match.
contracts.gameTimeCron: vercel.json runs GET /api/cron/game-time daily at 16:00 UTC (21:30 IST). Requires Authorization: Bearer CRON_SECRET (exempt from auth middleware). Sends a game-time notification (in-app + push, expires after a day) to every user with no score entered in the last 24h.
contracts.fastestRecords: Fastest-to records (lib/domain/fastestRecords.ts pure, lib/stats/fastestRecords.ts loads). Match-win record = fewest ended, non-DNF matches played when a player hit N match wins (N in RECORD_THRESHOLDS.matchWins = 1,5,10,25,50), matches ordered by endedAt. Game-win record = fewest rounds played when hitting N game wins (10,25,50,100,200,500), matches ordered by createdAt then round, rounds within each player DNF cutoff, DNF players skipped, live matches included, shared best score counts. Ties go to whoever got there first. Records are recomputed from history on request, so they move when broken. GET /api/records?game=<key>|_all -> { matchWins, gameWins: FastestRecordView[] } (holder identity + viewer own count). GET /api/matches/[id]/records -> { gameName, chances: RecordChanceView[] } for active matches: records in the match format an active roster player can still beat (match wins: winning this match; game wins: at most MAX_GAME_WINS_AWAY=5 wins away within the rounds budget). Shown as FastestRecords under the profile Leaderboard (follows its format) and RecordsOnTheLine in the live match sidebar. /api/records also takes scope=friends|global (friends = viewer + friends via lib/stats/friends.ts viewerAndFriendIds, holders recomputed among them with reachedBy) and returns viewerProgress per kind for the record flip card. /api/records?subject=<username> computes subjectReached/subjectProgress for that user (friend profiles show Fastest to from their point of view).
contracts.matchCelebrations: Milestone notifications created by onRoundsChanged/onMatchEnded carry payload.matchId. GET /api/matches/[id]/celebrations returns milestone notifications for roster users with that matchId from the last 30 minutes; MatchMilestoneCelebrations on the match page shows each once per viewer (localStorage match-celebrations-seen:<matchId>), auto-dismissing after 6s. The personal fly-to-profile banner still waits until the player leaves /matches/*.
contracts.homeFeed: Home page RelevantMatches row: the viewer live matches first (GET /api/matches?status=active), then friends matches from GET /api/matches/feed (friends matches the viewer is not in, live with at least one round or ended in the last 14 days, live first, max 12, top-3 standings). Friends of a match creator or player may watch it read-only: canWatchMatch in lib/api/viewableMatch.ts (pure checks in lib/domain/matchAccess.ts) gates GET match, state, rounds, forecast, recap, records and celebrations; writes keep their participant checks.
contracts.milestoneFriends: GET /api/milestones/friends returns { holders: Record<milestoneId, MilestoneFriendHolder[]> } for the viewer friends (earliest unlock first). Milestone cards show a FriendHolderStack (3 avatars then +N); the milestone flip card lists every friend who has it.
contracts.announcements: Notification type announcement: payload { title, body, url? }, kept until read. scripts/rename-game-label.ts renamed the Least Count - 2 label to Least Showdown (matches.gameLabel, notification text), rebuilt player stats and, with --announce, sent an announcement to every user.
contracts.leastShowdown: Least Showdown is gameType other with label Least Showdown (key least-showdown); catalog NAMED_VARIANTS / isLeastShowdown / rulesPathFor(gameType, gameLabel) -> /rules/least-showdown (docs/LEAST_SHOWDOWN.md). Scores may carry wrongShow:true (the declared total + 50 is stored as value). lib/domain/showdownStats.ts: correct show = round without a wrong show where exactly one player scored 0; wrong show = flagged player, or for an unflagged round with no 0 the unique highest score when it is at least 50 (the lowest score then beat the show); beat the show = others with value <= declared (value - 50). RoundForm showWrongShow adds a +50 toggle; ShowdownPanel flips between stats and the form and returns to stats after each submit; Scoreboard showdown marks cells and adds tally rows.
contracts.roundOutbox: POST /api/matches/[id]/rounds accepts clientRoundId; submitRound returns the existing round without inserting when that id is already stored (idempotent retries). Client: useSubmitRoundMutation queues the round in localStorage (roundOutboxStore, key playing-cards-round-outbox) on a network failure or when offline, keeping the optimistic cache; live match queries stop polling/refetching while rounds are queued; useRoundOutboxSync flushes in order on online, mount and every 15s, dropping a round the server rejects with a toast.
contracts.roundMoments: After each new round (exactly +1 round, never on load) LeaderboardSection shows RoundMomentOverlay for ~2.4s: standings before/after the latest round computed from the rounds alone (lib/domain/roundMoments.ts momentFromRounds), climbers get a Come on headline, fallers a gear-up line, rising game streaks (>=2) a fire badge that counts up; streak-only rounds get a single streak card. MatchMilestoneCelebrations adds milestoneTagline(roundContextFor(...)) so the tone fits the round (took lead, won, dropped, wrong show).

contracts2.types: Already added: MatchStanding.gameRuns?/currentGameRun? and PlayerStats.streaks (PlayerStreaks) + PlayerStats.milestones (AchievedMilestoneDoc[]) in collections.ts; PlayerStatsSummary.streaks/milestones, PlayerStreaksSummary, LeaderboardRow.currentGameStreak/currentMatchStreak, NotificationType 'milestone' in src/types/index.ts.
contracts2.gameStreakDefinition: Game streak = consecutive rounds won by a player (shared best score counts as a win; rounds a player has no score in are skipped, not breaks). Runs are computed per match and NOT carried across matches. longestGameStreak = max run across all matches; gameStreakCounts[k] = number of runs with length >= k across all matches (a 6-run counts once in 3,4,5,6). currentGameStreak = currentGameRun of the player's most recent ACTIVE match (0 if none active) — this is the fire badge.
contracts2.matchStreakDefinition: Match streak = consecutive ENDED matches (ordered by endedAt) where player rank===1 (ties count). DNF or non-1st breaks it. currentMatchStreak = trailing run.
contracts2.dayStreakDefinition: Active day = dayKey(Asia/Kolkata) of any round the player has a score in (score.enteredAt). longest/current via dayStreaks; stored lastActiveDay; API returns liveDayStreak(current,lastActiveDay,today) so a lapsed streak shows 0.
contracts2.milestoneFlow: After rebuildAllPlayerStats computes stats, for each user: newly = newlyReachedMilestones(statsAsMilestoneStats, existing ids); store mergeAchieved(...). BACKFILL: on the very first run (doc has no milestones field), record everything reached silently WITHOUT notifications, so existing players are not spammed. Otherwise send one 'milestone' notification per newly reached milestone: payload {milestoneId, title, emoji, metric, threshold}. Click target: /profile#milestones. Tracks/levels live in MILESTONE_TRACKS (each level has threshold + hero emoji; tier derives from level position). Adding a level never renames ids (metric:threshold). Unread milestone notifications are the unseen queue: MilestoneCelebrationBanner (app layout, skipped on /matches/*) shows them, tap anywhere flies the card into the header profile link (data-milestone-target="profile"), pulses ProfileGlow in the track colour and marks the notification read. Profile cards unlock from stat value OR stored id, so a new track shows unlocked before the next rebuild stores achievedAt.
contracts2.milestoneNoExpiry: 'milestone' and 'avatar-removed' notifications (KEEP_UNTIL_READ_TYPES in src/lib/notifications/create.ts) have expiresAt=null on insert. When marked read (PATCH /api/notifications/[id] and POST mark-all), set expiresAt=now+DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_TTL_MS for those rows so they vanish 2 days after being read. Unread ones never expire.
contracts2.fireBadge: Show 🔥N when current streak >= MIN_VISIBLE_STREAK. Places: profile Leaderboard rows (currentGameStreak; also ⚡N for currentMatchStreak>=2), live match leaderboard/podium rows (standing currentGameRun via a pure helper on the client from rounds data — the match page already has rounds), PlayerNameLink preview.
contracts2.statsApi2: GET /api/users/[username]/stats adds streaks (PlayerStreaksSummary, day streak live-adjusted) and milestones [{id, achievedAt ISO}]. GET /api/leaderboard rows add currentGameStreak/currentMatchStreak (same 3 queries, just project more fields).
